decisions.reason: The margin analysis runs on the firm's maintained market data, so keeping it costs little, and two years on the market are too few to show its value will not be realized.
The gas tariff comparison is close to the core offer and has its own page, and its upkeep on the shared databases is cheap, so holding the option remains sensible.
The electricity tariff calculator is a low-cost extension of the established tariff database, and nothing so far shows it has failed.
This line is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with Product C, so consolidation is possible, but it costs little to keep and has no clear negative signal, so the option stays open.
The area definition tool supports the other location-based products on the central platform, so it adds value to related options at little cost.
The site-specific comparison line partly overlaps with Product B and is only mentioned on the website, but its upkeep is cheap and its value is still uncertain, so it is kept for now.
